name: Monarch Sharma
headline: Cloud & DevOps Enthusiast — Kubernetes • Terraform • Azure • Containerization • CI/CD
tagline: I build and automate cloud infrastructure so deployments are reproducible, predictable and boring (in the best way).
about: Cloud / DevOps engineer focused on Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes and automation. I work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, automation, containers and DevOps.
My repositories are a mix of infrastructure automation, Kubernetes projects, CI/CD demonstrations, application deployments and experiments that help me understand how systems work from the ground up.
philosophy: Don't just learn the command. Understand what happens behind it.
quote: Infrastructure should be reproducible. Deployments should be automated.
